newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Jan-Sept tea crop rises to 188.3 mln kg.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Jan-Sept tea crop rises to 188.3 mln kg.

text.p: Sri Lanka's black tea output rose 2.4 percent to 188.3 million kg in the first nine months of 1996 from 183.9 million kg in the same 1995 period, the Tea Board said on Friday.
Output for September dropped by 7.4 percent to 18.7 million kg from 20.2 million kg a year earlier, a board statement said.
Production of the island's high grown teas dropped to 53.3 million kg in the January-September period from 55.7 million kg a year ago.
Low growns, which are popular with Russian and Middle East buyers, rose to 99.9 million kg during the September to January period from 89.9 million a year ago, the board said.
